name: siroheme to H2O
summary: A 4-step route from siroheme(8−) to H2O, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: siroheme decarboxylase
reactions.equation: siroheme + 2 H(+) = 12,18-didecarboxysiroheme + 2 CO2

reactions.name: 12,18-didecarboxysiroheme + 2 AH2 + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = Fe-coproporphyrin III +...
reactions.equation: 12,18-didecarboxysiroheme + 2 AH2 + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = Fe-coproporphyrin III + 2 5'-deoxyadenosine + 2 L-methionine + 2 acetate + 2 A + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: coproporphyrin ferrochelatase
reactions.equation: Fe-coproporphyrin III + 2 H(+) = coproporphyrin III + Fe(2+)

reactions.name: hydrogen peroxide-dependent heme synthase
reactions.equation: Fe-coproporphyrin III + 2 H2O2 + 2 H(+) = heme b + 2 CO2 + 4 H2O

reactions.name: PqqA peptide cyclase
reactions.equation: [PQQ precursor protein] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = E-Y cross-linked-[PQQ precursor protein] + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA carboxymethyluridine synthase
reactions.equation: uridine(34) in tRNA + acetyl-CoA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine + H2O = 5-(carboxymethyl)uridine(34) in tRNA + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + CoA + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: glycyl-[protein] + reduced [flavodoxin] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = glycin-2-yl radical...
reactions.equation: glycyl-[protein] + reduced [flavodoxin] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = glycin-2-yl radical-[protein] + semiquinone [flavodoxin] + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + H(+)

reactions.name: N-(9Z-octadecenoyl)-L-methionine + H2O = (9Z)-octadecenoate + L-methionine
reactions.equation: N-(9Z-octadecenoyl)-L-methionine + H2O = (9Z)-octadecenoate + L-methionine

reactions.name: dihydroalstonine + A = alstonine + AH2
reactions.equation: dihydroalstonine + A = alstonine + AH2

reactions.name: dihydroserpentine + A = serpentine + AH2
reactions.equation: dihydroserpentine + A = serpentine + AH2

reactions.name: sirohydrochlorin ferrochelatase
reactions.equation: siroheme + 2 H(+) = sirohydrochlorin + Fe(2+)

reactions.name: alpha-N-dichloroacetyl-p-aminophenylserinol N-oxygenase
reactions.equation: alpha-N-dichloroacetyl-p-aminophenylserinol + AH2 + 2 O2 = chloramphenicol + A + 2 H2O

reactions.name: 1'-hydroxy-gamma-carotene + A = 1'-hydroxytorulene + AH2
reactions.equation: 1'-hydroxy-gamma-carotene + A = 1'-hydroxytorulene + AH2

reactions.name: tRNA (uracil(54)-C(5))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: uridine(54) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5-methyluridine(54) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: 23S rRNA (uridine(2552)-2'-O)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: uridine(2552) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methyluridine(2552) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: CTP + AH2 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3'-deoxy-3',4'-didehydro-CTP + 5'-deoxyadenosine ...
reactions.equation: CTP + AH2 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3'-deoxy-3',4'-didehydro-CTP + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + A + H2O + H(+)

reactions.name: [methyl coenzyme M reductase]-L-arginine C-5-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: L-arginyl-[methyl-coenzyme M reductase] + AH2 + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = (5S)-C-methyl-L-arginyl-[methyl-coenzyme M reductase] + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + A + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: an N-(fatty acyl)-L-methionine + H2O = a fatty acid + L-methionine
reactions.equation: an N-(fatty acyl)-L-methionine + H2O = a fatty acid + L-methionine

reactions.name: GTP + AH2 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3'-deoxy-3',4'-didehydro-GTP + 5'-deoxyadenosine ...
reactions.equation: GTP + AH2 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3'-deoxy-3',4'-didehydro-GTP + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + A + H2O + H(+)

reactions.name: 1,1'-dihydroxy-1,1',2,2'-tetrahydrolycopene + A = 1,1'-dihydroxy-3,4-didehydro-1,2-dihy...
reactions.equation: 1,1'-dihydroxy-1,1',2,2'-tetrahydrolycopene + A = 1,1'-dihydroxy-3,4-didehydro-1,2-dihydrolycopene + AH2

reactions.name: cannabigerolate + A = cannabichromenate + AH2
reactions.equation: cannabigerolate + A = cannabichromenate + AH2
